<!-- - [Statically](https://cdn.statically.io/gh/0k-web/builds@main/jsdelivr/index.svg) -->

If you want to self host 0K, download a build like `selfhost-0k.zip` and host it on any static hosting service, from CodeHS and Techsmart, to Google Cloud Storage and S3, Firebase Hosting and Render Static, or even pages.gay and IPFS.

0K will explain how to set up a tunnel once you need to.
